description: This Java class 'WeightPackageServices' provides service methods for managing weight packages in an order shipment process, including setting package info, updating, deleting, completing packages, and saving package details within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: WeightPackageServices
classes.description: Service class for handling weight package operations in shipment processing.

methods.name: setPackageInfo
methods.description: Sets package information such as weight and dimensions, validating input and ensuring package quantity does not exceed ordered quantity.

methods.name: updatePackedLine
methods.description: Updates details of a specific packed line, including dimensions, weight, and shipment box type.

methods.name: deletePackedLine
methods.description: Deletes a specific packed line from the session.

methods.name: completePackage
methods.description: Completes the packaging process, setting shipment and invoice details, and finalizing the package.

methods.name: completeShipment
methods.description: Finalizes the shipment, marking it as complete within the system.

methods.name: savePackagesInfo
methods.description: Saves package information related to an order, including shipping costs.
